relevance_note: Two identifiable patients of this IPEX-like cohort carry germline TNFAIP3 variants (Table III: "| S027 | TNFAIP3 | c.1127delC, p.S376fs" and "| S087 | TNFAIP3 | c.G2300A, p.C767Y"), each with sex, age, features and genotype.
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema (schema_ha20_v5.json) and extraction_rules_v1.md; nothing was filled from outside knowledge. Scope (D-22): only the two patients with a TNFAIP3 variant are in scope, S027 and S087 (Table II and Table III). The remaining members of the 123-patient IPEX-like cohort (other genes) get no rows and are counted in publications.cohort_size_as_stated. The paper describes no relative of a TNFAIP3 patient (the 'infant son' of patient S92 and the 'previously deceased siblings' of S066 and SDH belong to patients without TNFAIP3 variants), so no relative rows. Table II/III were read by eye and transcribed by hand into this file (no script transcribed them); I re-checked each quote against the markdown. Decisions and uncertainties: (1) Table II has no per-patient reference/source column, so source_reference_in_review = 'not reported' for both people. (2) The Table II column is headed only 'Age'; Table I refers to 'Age at referral', so the printed ages (3 y, 12 y) were recorded under age_at_last_evaluation_* and not under age at diagnosis or onset. (3) publications.n_patients_reported = 2 is my count of the patients with a TNFAIP3 variant from the two Table II rows; the authors never state such a number themselves. (4) cites_prior_report_of_same_patients = false with span null: the paper states that 20 of its variants 'had been previously reported' (in ClinVar, per reference 15), which is not a statement that any of its patients were described earlier; it makes no such statement about patients. (5) variant_type_as_stated: for S027 the paper states 'Truncating mutation' (Type column 'LoF'); as the enum has no 'truncating' value I recorded 'frameshift'. For S087 no class is printed for this variant, so 'not reported' (not derived from the HGVS string). (6) The Table III column 'Type / PPH2 / gerp' contains stacked values in the header and, for S087, the cell '1.00 / 5.7' (D-31): these stacked values were not read positionally and were used for nothing. (7) Stacked cells: none of the TNFAIP3 rows has a ' / ' cell that could be read per patient. (8) disease_label_as_stated = 'not reported' for both: the paper gives no disease name for them (they are listed under the heading 'IUIS: Autoinflammatory disorders', a classification heading, not a per-person diagnosis). (9) treatment_summary = 'not reported' for both: the Discussion says 'Patients with CARD14 and TNFAIP3 mutations often respond to TNF-alpha inhibitors and to IL12/IL23 inhibitors', a general statement, not a treatment reported for these individuals. (10) S027's 'watery diarrhea' was not mapped to the checklist item 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation', which names ulcers or inflammation only. (11) is_proband = true for both: the Limitations state 'only probands were available for initial analysis', a statement about the patients analyzed in this study. (12) Checklist: S027 has eczema -> skin lesions observed, failure to thrive -> growth failure observed, autoantibodies to thyroid -> autoantibodies (ANA/other) observed, 'without frank thyroiditis' -> autoimmune thyroiditis excluded; S087 has only the entry '“IPEX”', which is a broad composite and was not mapped onto any single checklist item, so all 20 items are 'not reported' for S087. (13) No contradictions were found inside the paper for these two people.
